svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut an 80 mm disc as for the mains board; no notches.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three holes 3.4 mm on a 60 mm circle at 0, 120 and 240 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Light sensor at the exact centre, on the top face; the light pipe

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends 0.5 mm above it once the dome is on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Radio module breakout 16 x 16 mm on the street side, its u.FL socket

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: toward the right edge (seen from the pole) for the antenna lead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Supercapacitor 10 mm across, 20 mm tall, standing 24 mm toward the pole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 6 mm to the right of the centre, clear of the screw heads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clock, accelerometer, 0 to 10 V stage and coil drive on the rest.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: three M3 x 6 screws into the standoffs, top of board 70.2 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: above the underside of the base.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: nothing on the top face stands taller than 22 mm.
